channel.title: Devops on Ced's Home Lab
channel.description: Recent content in Devops on Ced's Home Lab

item.title: From Football to Kubernetes: How I Reinvented Myself Through Technology (Part 1)
item.description: Before the Kubernetes clusters and Proxmox nodes, there was Paris KY, a football scholarship, and a kid who didn't yet know where his curiosity belonged.

item.title: How Trash Computers Built Ced's Home Lab (Part 2)
item.description: Ced's Home Lab didn't start with expensive servers, enterprise gear, or fancy cloud infrastructure. It started with trash. No, seriously. Literal trash.

item.title: Zero Open Ports: How I Expose 28 Homelab Services Without Touching My Router
item.description: How I went from memorizing IP addresses to running 28 homelab services securely accessible from anywhere in the world without opening a single port on my router.

item.title: How I Built a Live NOC Dashboard for My Homelab Using Grafana + Prometheus
item.description: How I built a real-time homelab NOC dashboard using Grafana, Prometheus, Blackbox Exporter, Kubernetes, and Proxmox to monitor infrastructure like an enterprise environment and the hard lessons learned along the way.
